rules: ALDOT prices K and A alike and B and C alike (one KA and one BC cost); CrashIQ applies them per level as given
the form doesn't state the dollar year

statewide_rates.missing: ALDOT's Safety Management Section supplies crash rates on request (HSIP report 2025); no statewide average-rate table was found in its public manuals, and CrashIQ has no Alabama traffic counts

screening.state_method: ALDOT selects HSIP projects by benefit/cost (HSIP application, Worksheets 2a-3)

min_years.missing: the HSIP application asks for the crash history at the site but its tabs found here set no minimum study period

spf_calibration.missing: ALDOT reports it is developing HSM procedures (HSIP report 2023); no calibration factors published
